question.wording: Was this employer-plan disability pension (Form 1099-R box 7 code 3) received before the taxpayer reached the minimum retirement age the employer set?

options.label: Yes — before the minimum retirement age; it is wages on line 1h
No — at or after it; it is a pension on lines 5a and 5b

citation.wording: Disability pensions shown on Form 1099-R if you haven't reached the minimum retirement age set by your employer.
